faq.a: Buy now, pay later (BNPL) splits a purchase into small installments — usually 4 payments every 2 weeks (Klarna, Afterpay, Zip) or monthly installments (Affirm). This tracker puts all your BNPL loans in one calendar so no payment sneaks up on you.
faq.q: What is buy now, pay later?

faq.a: It depends on the provider. Some charge late fees, some pause your account, and some report missed payments to credit bureaus. Check your agreement with each provider — the tracker flags payments that land close together so you can plan ahead.
faq.q: What happens if I miss a BNPL payment?

faq.a: Some BNPL loans are reported to credit bureaus and some are not — it varies by provider and by loan. Paying on time is the safe rule either way.
faq.q: Does BNPL affect my credit score?

faq.a: List every loan with its next due date. The calendar shows the soonest payment first — pay that one first, then work down the list. If two payments land in the same week, the tracker warns you.
faq.q: How do I pay off BNPL fastest?
